title: Duplicate entries in Nighscout (already asked on cgm-remote-monitor and redirected to here)
body:
Which device / browser version was used to reproduce the bug? Chrome Version 68.0.3440.59 (Build officiel) beta (64 bits)/Personnal computer and Chrome 67.0.3396.87 on my mobile device (Xiaomi Redmi 4G)

I am using Dev version of Nighscout, AndroidAPS and the latest version of XDrip. When I enter the carbs in APS calculator (and consequently receive insulin), from time to time, the information apears duplicated on NS screen . Please note that i have not entered manually the BG though it mentions "BG Manual". In Nightscout reports a double entry is founded (see attached image)
It's not a consistant issue, i.e. it doesn't happen every time but happened also with previsous versions of NS/Xdrip.

Thanks :)
